note: Reviewed catalog of the system interfaces the Swift host links against, and that Roc's run-mode shims import when `roc main.roc` links the host (run_shim). Every library names its install name and every symbol its own public evidence; the generated stubs list only these names, and no Apple SDK file is read or shipped. PROVENANCE.md states the rules.

run_shim.evidence: Roc's run mode (`roc main.roc`, `roc run`, `--opt=dev` or `--opt=interpreter`) links the platform host with one of the compiler's own shim archives, libroc_machine_code_shim.a or libroc_interpreter_shim.a, which roc embeds and extracts for every run. Their system imports are the macOS imports roc-lang/roc's src/machine_code_shim/archive_check.zig allows (darwin_imports, c_memory_set, c_math_set). These are the ones the shims of the supported compilers reference (`nm -u`, which scripts/build.roc's audit re-checks against the `roc` it builds with); each is owned by a library below with its own evidence.
